title: String loops
description:
Every string is zero-terminated. In the tests `"text"` is a string and `@"text"` one the function may change; `buf(32)` is 32 zero bytes of space.

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `length(s)` | the characters before the 0 |
| `count_char(s, c)` | how many times the character c appears |
| `to_lower(s)` | changes `'A'` to `'Z'` into lower case, in place |
| `copy(dest, src)` | copies src with its 0 into dest |
| `equal(a, b)` | 1 if the two strings are the same, else 0 |
| `find_char(s, c)` | the **index** of the first c, or −1 |

starter.solution.asm:
length:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

count_char:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

to_lower:
        ret

copy:
        ret

equal:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

find_char:
        mov     rax, -1
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
length:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  cmp     byte [rdi + rax], 0
        je      .done
        inc     rax
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

count_char:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  movzx   ecx, byte [rdi]
        test    cl, cl
        jz      .done
        cmp     cl, sil
        jne     .next
        inc     rax
.next:  inc     rdi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

to_lower:
.loop:  movzx   eax, byte [rdi]
        test    al, al
        jz      .done
        lea     ecx, [rax - 'A']
        cmp     ecx, 25
        ja      .next                   ; not 'A'..'Z'
        add     al, 32
        mov     [rdi], al
.next:  inc     rdi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

copy:
.loop:  movzx   eax, byte [rsi]
        mov     [rdi], al
        inc     rsi
        inc     rdi
        test    al, al
        jnz     .loop
        ret

equal:
.loop:  movzx   eax, byte [rdi]
        cmp     al, [rsi]
        jne     .no
        test    al, al
        jz      .yes
        inc     rdi
        inc     rsi
        jmp     .loop
.yes:   mov     eax, 1
        ret
.no:    xor     eax, eax
        ret

find_char:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  movzx   ecx, byte [rdi + rax]
        cmp     cl, sil
        je      .done
        test    cl, cl
        jz      .none
        inc     rax
        jmp     .loop
.none:  mov     rax, -1
.done:  ret

hints: `to_lower` must leave `'@'` and `'['` alone: they sit just before `'A'` and just after `'Z'`. The unsigned range trick checks both ends in one compare: subtract `'A'`, then `cmp` with 25 and `ja`.
unitTests:
test "length"
    length("hello") == 5
    length("") == 0
    length("a b c") == 5
test "count_char"
    count_char("banana", 'a') == 3
    count_char("banana", 'z') == 0
    count_char("", 'a') == 0
test "to_lower"
    to_lower(@"Hello, World 42!") => "hello, world 42!"
    to_lower(@"ABC@[XYZ") => "abc@[xyz"
    to_lower(@"") => ""
test "copy"
    copy(buf(32), "assembly") => "assembly"
    copy(buf(8), "") => ""
test "equal"
    equal("same", "same") == 1
    equal("same", "sane") == 0
    equal("short", "shorter") == 0
    equal("", "") == 1
test "find_char"
    find_char("hello", 'l') == 2
    find_char("hello", 'h') == 0
    find_char("hello", 'z') == -1
